title: Run elapsed is TUI-derived, not in the model, and grows after the run ends
description:
watchRunElapsed takes the earliest tries[].dispatched_at to generated_at; no contract field carries it (so the phone cannot show it) and it is never clamped at the run's end, so a finished run's header keeps counting.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go:1205-1235
